nodes.question: What are solar fuels (SFS) and why are they important in decarbonizing energy and chemical production?
nodes.answer: Solar fuels, also known as e-fuels, are high-energy-density vectors that can substitute fossil fuels. They are crucial in decarbonizing energy and chemical production as they should have similar characteristics to fossil fuels in terms of ease of transport and long-term storage, but with a carbon footprint reduction of over 70%.
